<Bright>Adaptor </><TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD"/><Bright>:</> Throw a volley of kunai at the target, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/> physical damage. <dim>Adaptor </><TFTAttribute icon="icon.AP"></><dim>: If the Ability kills, cast it again.</>

Then slam the current target, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage and Stunning them for <TFTCurveTable row="StunDuration"/> seconds.

ability.name: Moonfall
ability.desc:
Rain <TFTCurveTable row="NumMoonshards"/> moonshards split among the <TFTCurveTable row="NumEnemies"/> nearest enemies, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage each.

If the moon is full, instead crash it onto the board, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/> magic damage split among all enemies.

<Bright>Passive:</> Every second, restore <TFTAttribute style="colorHealth" icon="icon.AP, icon.Health" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/> Health and deal <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage to enemies within <TFTCurveTable row="PassiveHexRadius"/> hex.

<Bright>Active:</> Deal <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc3"/> magic damage to enemies within <TFTCurveTable row="BigHexRadius"/> hexes and Stun them for <TFTCurveTable row="StunDuration"/> seconds, increased to <TFTAttribute style="" icon="" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1" precision="1"/> seconds if the target is <Keyword>Burning</>.

<Rules>Burn: Deals a percent of the target’s max Health as true damage every second.</>

ability.desc:
Equip Severum and swipe the target <TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AS" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1"/> times over <TFTCurveTable row="Duration"/> seconds, each dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/> physical damage. 

After the onslaught finishes, fire a blast that deals <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2"/> physical damage split among all enemies in a 2 Hex radius.

ability.name: Spirit Rift
ability.desc:
Fire an arrow through the most enemies in a line that deals <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD"/> physical damage, reduced by <TFTCurveTable row="DamageFalloffPerEnemy" format="percent"/> per enemy hit (minimum <TFTCurveTable row="MinDamagePercent" format="percent"/>). 

The arrow leaves a trail for <TFTCurveTable row="RiftDuration"/> seconds that deals <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, icon.AP"/> + <TFTCurveTable row="MaxHealthDamagePerSecond" style="colorPhysical" format="percent"/> max Health physical damage per second to enemies within and <TFTCurveTable row="ChillPercent"/>% <Keyword>Slows</> them.

These attacks are replaced by commands which direct each soldier to deal <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage per attack.

ability.name: Crimson Fury
ability.desc:
<bright>Passive:</> When the target dies, leap at the next target, dealing <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD"/> physical damage.

<bright>Active:</> Gain <TFTCurveTable row="FrenzyADPercent" style="colorStat" format="percent"/> Attack Damage for <TFTCurveTable row="Duration"/> seconds. During this time ignore <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1" style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" format="percent"/> Armor.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Red Buff:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">Attacks <TFTCurveTable row="BurnAmount"/>%</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="Keyword" inactiveStyle="dim">Burn</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">enemies and heal Brambleback for</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim"><TFTCurveTable row="TraitMaxHealthHeal" format="percent"/></> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">max Health.</>

ability.desc: Poison the target and the nearest non-poisoned enemy, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage over <TFTCurveTable row="Duration"/> seconds. Poisons stack.

ability.name: Razor Leaves
ability.desc:
Summon five razor-sharp leaves that converge on the current target, dealing a total of <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/> physical damage and applying <TFTCurveTable row="WoundLevel"/>% <Keyword>Wound</> and <TFTCurveTable row="BurnAmount"/>% <Keyword>Burn</> for <TFTCurveTable row="WoundDuration"/> seconds.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Scarlet Buff:</><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim"> Cinderling gains</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim"><TFTCurveTable row="TraitADOnCast" format="percent"/></> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">Attack Damage each cast.</>

ability.name: Flock Family
ability.desc:
Summon 4 untargetable Tiny Beaks nearby for <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1" style="colorStat" precision="1" icon="icon.AP"/> seconds. Whenever Mama Beak attacks, Tiny Beaks attack the same enemy, dealing <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD"/> physical damage.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Orange Buff:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">Dealing physical damage reduces enemy Armor by </><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="colorStat" inactiveStyle="dim"><TFTCurveTable row="ArmorReduc"/></><TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">.</>

ability.name: Pale Barrier
ability.desc: Gain <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1" style="colorStat"/> shield for <TFTCurveTable row="ShieldDuration"/> seconds and send out <TFTCurveTable row="NumOrbs"/> moonlight orbs spread among enemies within 2 hexes, each dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> magic damage.

ability.name: Whirling Death
ability.desc:
<bright>Passive:</> Attacks target random enemies in range and apply a bleed that deals <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" precision="0"/> physical damage over <TFTCurveTable row="BleedDuration"/> seconds. Every attack has a <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1" style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" format="percent" precision="0"/> chance to deal <TFTCurveTable row="SpinningAxeDamageRatio" format="percentminusone" style="colorStat"/> bonus physical damage and apply <TFTCurveTable row="SpinningAxeBleedStacks"/> bleeds instead. 

<bright>Active:</> Throw two giant axes towards the enemy with the most bleeds. Deal <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc3" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" precision="0"/> physical damage to enemies hit and consume their bleed, instantly dealing the remaining damage. The axes then return, dealing <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc2" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" precision="0"/> physical damage to enemies hit.

<Bright>Active:</> Become invulnerable and fly into the air. On return, stun all enemies for <TFTCurveTable row="StunDuration"/> seconds, gain <TFTCurveTable row="Omnivamp" format="percent" style="colorStat"/> Omnivamp, and Ignite them for <TFTCurveTable row="IgniteDuration"/> seconds.  Ignited enemies take <TFTCurveTable row="IgniteMaxHealthDamage" format="percent" style="colorPhysical"/> max Health physical damage per second. Replace this ability with Flame Breath and immediately cast it.

<Bright>Flame Breath:</>  Spew fire at the most enemies in a line through the target, dealing <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2" style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD, icon.AP"/> physical damage, reduced by <TFTCurveTable row="DamageReductionPerHit" format="percent"/> for each enemy it passes through (minimum <TFTCurveTable row="MinimumDamageThreshold" format="percent"/>.) Ignite those enemies for <TFTCurveTable row="IgniteDuration"/> seconds.

<TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="bright" inactiveStyle="dim">Elder Dragon Buff:</> <TFTConditionalStyle tag="Set18.Trait.Riftbeast.Selected" activeStyle="default" inactiveStyle="dim">Damaging an enemy below <TFTCurveTable row="TraitExecuteThreshold" format="percent"/> Health executes them.</>

ability.name: Rage Gene
ability.desc:
<Bright>Passive:</> Gain <TFTCurveTable row="RagePerSecond"/> Rage per second and <TFTCurveTable row="RagePerAttack"/> Rage per attack. 

<Bright>Active:</> Transform into Mega Gnar and leap into the largest group of enemies within <TFTCurveTable row="TransformSearchRadius"/> hexes. Then, deal <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc3"/> physical damage to enemies within <TFTCurveTable row="TransformHexRadius"/> hexes, reduce their Armor and Magic Resist by <TFTAttribute style="colorStat" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.GenericCalc1"/>, and Stun them for <TFTCurveTable row="StunDuration"/> second. Mega Gnar gains <TFTAttribute style="colorStat" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.HealthCalc1"/> Health, and replaces his Ability with Grab n' Throw.

<Bright>Grab n' Throw:</> Throw the target at the farthest enemy, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc1"/> physical damage to them and <TFTAttribute style="colorPhysical" icon="icon.AD" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.PhysicalDamageCalc2"/> physical damage to enemies they pass through. If there's only 1 enemy left, throw them off the battlefield instead.

ability.name: Spirit of Dread

<bright>Active:</> Grant <TFTCurveTable row="NumAlliesToShield"/> allies <TFTAttribute attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.ShieldCalc1" icon="icon.AP, icon.DamageAmp" style="colorStat"/> Shield and <TFTCurveTable row="DamageAmpAmount" style="colorStat" format="percent"/> Damage Amp for <TFTCurveTable row="ShieldDuration"/> seconds. After casting <TFTCurveTable row="CastThreshold"/> times, also grant <TFTCurveTable row="AttackSpeed" style="colorStat" format="percentminusone"/> stacking Attack Speed to targets.

ability.name: Solar Judgement

<Bright>1st Ascension:</> Attacks deal <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc1"/> bonus magic damage.
<Bright>2nd Ascension:</> Attacks <TFTCurveTable row="ShredLevel"/>% <Keyword>Shred</> enemies hit for <TFTCurveTable row="ShredDuration"/> seconds. 
<Bright>3rd Ascension:</> Attacks fire waves, dealing <TFTAttribute style="colorMagic" icon="icon.AP" attributeID="TFTCalculationAttributes.MagicDamageCalc2"/> magic damage to all other units hit.
<Bright>4th Ascension:</> Gain infinite range. Every <TFTCurveTable row="NumAttacksForBigWave4Star"/>rd wave is much larger.
